generator: Built-in ImageGen for original art; native PNG export for frame registration, palette variants and independent volume layers.
coordinate_origin: top-left image coordinates; convert Y for pico2d clip_draw
sprite_layout: Each animation is a horizontal strip. Use the actual frames count; cat atlases have 8 columns and 9 rows with transparent unused cells.
limits: Static PNG validation only; game-engine playback and full animation transitions were not tested.
Rainbow fur uses fixed palette bands; other five skins share exactly the same alpha geometry.
Ground and platform edge matching requires verification in the final game map.
Generated source sheets are preserved separately; use normalized png/ files, not raw sources.
